questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark ‘(?)’ in the following equation, if ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

57 ÷ 9 × 50 − 5 + 2 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

57 ÷ 9 × 50 − 5 + 2 = ?

Replace the operators with their corresponding new meanings:

57 − 9 + 50 ÷ 5 × 2 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= 57 − 9 + **50 ÷ 5**__ × 2

= 57 − 9 + __**10 × 2**__

= __**57 **__− 9 __**+ 20**__

= **__77 - 9__** = 68

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: In a certain code language 'JRZQ' is coded as '74' and 'LOBT' is coded as '118'. What is the code for 'XGCF' in the given language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

The logic followed here is.

Logic: (Sum of reverse positional values of letters) × 2.

Let's consider the reverse positional values (A=26, B=25, ... Z=1).

For JRZQ:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1efa8d9515cda7b8ab9b9f98d546c07626b37c72848a799056e9622e238801a1.png] 

Sum of reverse positional values = 17 + 9 + 1 + 10 = 37

Code = 37 × 2 = 74.

For LOBT:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01b79a4e7ef4c9326354c7260867d26a05e9262b42d88adac819dc1033d5a6f9.png] 

Sum of reverse positional values = 15 + 12 + 25 + 7 = 59

Code = 59 × 2 = 118.

**Similarly, let's find the code for XGCF:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14f54e314cab6faefbafd37232e6eca1f1c768b2ce5988bd4aa1b94a16bf9193.png] 

Sum of reverse positional values = 3 + 20 + 24 + 21 = 68

Code = 68 × 2 = 136

Therefore, the code for 'XGCF' is 136.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All pumps are motors.

All pumps are machines.

All engines are machines.

Conclusions:

(I): All engines are motors.

(II): Some machines are motors.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All pumps are motors.

All pumps are machines.

All engines are machines.

The least possible Venn diagrams for the given statement are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cafe82775e2657e61bb96534468d033890032a1a11d976ad58ae25fea38e300.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All engines are motors - **False** (There is no direct connection established between engines and motors in the statements that guarantees all engines are motors.)

II. Some machines are motors - **True** (Since all pumps are motors and all pumps are machines, it logically follows that some machines must be motors. The area representing 'Pumps' is common to both 'Machines' and 'Motors', ensuring an intersection.)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – G, I, F and T are seated and all of them are facing south

In row 2 – B, O, N and D are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus each person faces another person from the other row.

No one sits to the right of B. Only two people sit between N and B. The one facing O sits second to the right of the one facing B. I sits to the immediate right of F. G sits to the immediate right of I and doesn't face O.

Which of the following represents both people sitting at the extreme ends of the rows?
questions.solution:
Given, Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – G, I, F and T are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2 – B, O, N and D are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus each person faces another person from the other row.

No one sits to the right of B.

Only two people sit between N and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fad5246718441c7faebdcbc0450bc27db1393435eab4fb27f310dd65c9859339.png] 

The one facing O sits second to the right of the one facing B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7434f921cd9b63b6c2a94a1cba4638142244e93ee0067bfe86ae621d9cb8df8.png] 

I sits to the immediate right of F.

G sits to the immediate right of I and doesn't face O.

T and D sit at the remaining place according to thier direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e46abdcd8ae3147880f5498a1e27abbfeb6af5fc300edc69d49f3d5c7924ec94.png] 

From the options, T and N are sitting at the extreme ends of the rows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
